title: Fate/stay night [Réalta Nua]

versions.note: A PS2 emulator names this build SLPM-66513-f6c5993b

sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
Played from power-on: the prologue's opening, 60 presses over three scenes

What the script said in play agreed with what each of 36 pictures had gained, over 3 scenes. 16 further screens were played and not read; no screen without text and no choice was among them; furigana were seen on one text
notes: Read by the script games/ps2/SLPM-66513.lua. What is on the page is kept as one Shift-JIS string made ready for drawing, with marks that begin with a percent sign (colour, size, indent, new row, a dash's length, a word with its reading). A press adds to its end and a new page begins it anew: the script says what the string gained once it stands still. The game shows no speaker's name. Choices, menus and the backlog aren't read.
